learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 38 New York products (state term 81) of 298 across 11 states, one page. Doses read off the rendered product pages, one per line.
notes: Custom post type 'product' with taxonomies category, post_tag and state; state=81 is New York (AZ 60, IL 91, MI 203, MO 61, NV 62, NJ 64, OH 82, OR 63, PA 125). The category term names (tags here) carry the line: Mega, Pearls, Pips, Chocolate, 'Rosin Mega - NY', 'Rosin Pearls - NY'.

Titles are a ratio prefix and a flavour ('THC Lemonade', '1:1 Strawberry Lemonade', '3:1 Milk Chocolate'); rosin products are the bare flavour ('Cherry Cola'). Some titles hold
, which the reader strips.

Neither the title nor the REST content has a dose; the product pages do, fixed per line: a Mega is one 100mg piece ('one whole Mega is 100mg THC'); Pearls are 10 per package at 10mg; Pips are 20 per package at 5mg; full bars and Mini Bars are 10 pieces at 10mg. Rosin Mega and Rosin Pearls pages reuse the same blocks.

The 10:1 CBN:THC Tart Cherry Pearls page shows the generic 10mg-a-Pearl block, which its own ratio contradicts. 8 NY stores sell it as 25mg THC (2.5mg x 10 Pearls; 2 stores write 100mg), so it is set to 10pk 25mg. Recheck if the page ever states its dose.

Rosin Mega and Rosin Pearls are given the line Mega and Pearls, the way NY stores write them; their flavours (Cherry Cola, Peach Mango, Baja Blaze, Electric Honeydew, Dragon Punch, Orange Yuzu) exist only in rosin, so nothing collides.

Gummy strains drop the ratio prefix: each gummy flavour comes in one ratio, and stores write the flavour alone. Chocolates keep it (not 'THC'), because one flavour comes as THC and as a ratio ('THC Dark Chocolate Pips' and '1:1:1 Dark Chocolate Pips'). Full bars have no line; Mini Bars have the line 'Mini Bar'.
One New York product has an Illinois slug (mega-1-1-blackberry-il) and repeats mega-1-1-blackberry-ny; it is skipped.

PIXLZ, Grön's gummy-cluster sub-brand that NY stores sell under Grön, is on its own Webflow site (eatpixlz.com: Blue Razzberry 3:1, Tropical Rush, Berry Blast), not in this feed. A recipe reads one source, so PIXLZ stays with the stores' consensus.

Stores call the NY Sour Apple Mega 'Big Apple' (its page: 'gives the term Big Apple a whole new meaning') and the Mini Bars 'Sea Salt' bars; the site's names are kept, so those store names show as only at stores.
Stores call the Mega Sour Apple 'Big Apple' (store_aliases).

2026-10-08 curation: NY stores often write the per-piece 10mg as a Pearls or Mini Bar listing's size; the gap fill turned these into 10mg 'sizes' of the site products (Lychee Limeade, Tangelo, Watermelon, Wildberry). No Grön NY package is 10mg (Pearls 10 x 10mg, bars 10 x 10mg, Mega 1 x 100mg, Pips 20 x 5mg, PIXLZ 20 x 5mg, Pearls 2-pack 2 x 10mg), so store_skip drops every 10mg store size.
Tart Cherry Pearls' package (Dutchie photo 8f8589fc...) prints '10:1 - 250MG CBN & 25MG THC PER PACKAGE, 25MG CBN & 2.5MG THC PER PEARL': 10pk 25mg is right, and the stores' 10pk 100mg is skipped.

Stores also write the chocolate's lineage as its name (Indica, Sativa, Sleepy Indica, Daytime Sativa) and call the Mini Bars 'Dark/Milk Chocolate Sea Salt' across THC and ratio bars; none of these is one product, so they are skipped and the matcher decides those listings. 'Milk Chocolate Sativa Full Bar' is the site's THC Milk Chocolate full bar (its page: 'Sativa THC Milk Chocolate', 10 servings), so it is aliased.

New tarot-themed rosin drops not on the site feed yet (2026-10-08): MEGA 'Mellow Moon' (XVIII, indica, 1 x 100mg, yuzu melon flavour) and Pearls 'Star Spell' (XVII, sativa, 10 pearls, 100mg, star fruit flavour), per their packages on Dutchie. Some stores' enrichment read the flavour as the strain (Yuzu Melon, Star Fruit); those copies are skipped so each product has one store-only entry.
